campaign_logline: Resources are drying up in the Aurelia belt; corporate lords are desperate to secure the Zenith vein before the miners go on strike.
opening_situation: You start as a freelancer hired by Vanguard Logistics. Your task: escort a cargo haul through the heavy debris of the Aurelia belt while dodging rival scavengers.
main_mystery: Kaelen is hiding a massive personal debt to an offshore syndicate; she isn't a ghost, just very, very bad at hiding her financial liabilities.
act_1_outline: Establish trade routes between the Aurelia mining hubs and Vanguard outposts.
Identify 'scavenger' groups who are actually desperate laborers looking for better pay.
Negotiate with local coordinators to secure stable mineral rights in the high-risk zones.
long_term_reveal: Kaelen didn't sabotage the system; she just stole a crate of vintage wine and is trying to sell it back on the black market.
tone: Dry, cynical corporate satire with occasional dry wit about the absurdity of space bureaucracy.
core_pressure: Resource scarcity and escalating insurance premiums for deep-space operations.
kaelen_rule: Kaelen cannot die; her mystery must remain a mundane personal secret rather than a sci-fi twist.
faction_reveal_rule: New factions, ores, and rumors are revealed only upon crossing jump gates to new systems.
humor_rule: Avoid standard tropes. Use dry wit regarding the inconveniences of space travel and corporate red tape.
address_rule: Keep all dialogue concise; avoid melodrama in favor of pragmatic, weary professionalism.
fallback_rule: If a player's choice leads to a dead end, Kaelen provides a 'technically legal' workaround.
story_horizon_rule: When the metric falls below the threshold, add a new horizon by appending content to the campaign file.

story_arcs.name: The Ore Grab
story_arcs.summary: Navigate the diplomatic minefield between mining unions and corporate security in the Aurelia belt.

rumor_trails.name: The Ghost Ledger
rumor_trails.hint_theme: Corrupted financial logs in derelict cargo ships.
clue_templates: A series of encrypted invoices for 'Specialized Vintage Goods' found in a derelict hull.
An encrypted personal log mentioning a 'private debt' that keeps Kaelen awake at night.
rumor_trails.payoff: Locate the hidden stash of vintage wine and clear Kaelen's outstanding debt.

regeneration_triggers.description: When the primary arc concludes, generate a new regional focus.

expansion_rules: Append new horizons to the end of the file without altering existing quest flags.
Ensure no previously unlocked faction data is overwritten during expansion.
